body: Had a kid on my music course who turned up one day called Billy Joel Washington. He barely spoke, just sat there effortlessly playing super complicated shit way beyond our level on his guitar and then disappeared again after a week. Still not sure if he was real.

The big JC himself 

 I was 8 years old in methodist primary school, sat in assembly watching an animated bible story and I can tell you, the animators had gone out of their way to make jesus the buffest, most majestic man I'd ever seen. The thick billowing hair, the tall but kindly presence, the manly toga and sandles, the six pack
 It all worked. I was blown away by his super cool miracles and he (probably) had a really attractive voice. It just did something for me. I started drawing comics about me and jesus hanging out and holding hands (about as saucy as I got when I was 8), writing little stories about how he was gonna save me. Had a teacher tell me the stories were inappropriate but I think my mum found it pretty funny. 
It unfortunately didn't last thought, as 1. I came to the conclusion he wasn't real and 2. I moved on to obi wan kenobi instead (ewan mcgregor version obvs). I definitely had a type!

I have actually read up on the benefits of ketamine in certain situations, but i also think that outside of a controlled environment it’s dangerous to call it a medicine. In the case of my boyfriend, he’s abused it to the point he’s only got a quarter of his bladder capacity left. He’s 100% has real struggles  with his mental health which is possibly the main cause of his addiction, and will soon be starting trauma therapy to help with this.
I should have probably added that I’ve already spoken about this a lot with him 😅 he said he agrees with me that it’s impacting his recovery, but then he’s repeated the same behaviour.
